Class Bat

java.lang.Object
Creature
Bat
public class Bat extends Creature
Represents the generic flying creature Bat.

Extends the Creature class. Bats have varying statistics depending on which dungeon it is in.

  • Method Details

    • tick

      public boolean tick(Floor floor)
      Reduces the Bat's move cooldown by one. Once it reaches 0, it resets the curCooldown to the moveInterval and takes its turn. If the Player is adjacent to the Bat on its turn, the Bat attacks the Player, else the bat moves to a random valid adjacent space. The bat is also able to move diagonally on the 3rd Dungeon. The bat also triggers any Structure Idle effects if it does not move during its turn.
      Specified by:
      tick in class Creature
      Parameters:
      floor - the Floor the Bat is on, allows the Bat to search and move on it.
      Returns:
      true if the Bat died as a result of its turn.
